components.name: Item
responsibilities: Map the items table to the domain aggregate root Item
Hold id (Long, PK, unique, generated), name (String, @NotBlank), quantity (Integer, @NotNull, @Min(0))
Enforce bean validation constraints at the persistence boundary

components.name: CreateItemRequest
responsibilities: Immutable request payload for creating an Item
Carry name with @NotBlank and quantity with @NotNull @Min(0)

components.name: UpdateItemRequest
responsibilities: Immutable request payload for updating an existing Item
Carry name with @NotBlank and quantity with @NotNull @Min(0)

components.name: ItemResponse
responsibilities: Immutable response payload representing a persisted Item
Expose id, name and quantity to API clients

components.name: ItemNotFoundException
responsibilities: Signal that no Item exists for a supplied identifier
Carry the missing id for diagnostic logging

components.name: ItemRepository
responsibilities: Provide CRUD persistence operations for the Item aggregate
Extend JpaRepository<Item, Long> for save, findById, findAll and deleteById
Isolate all JPA/Spring Data access from the service layer

components.name: ItemService
responsibilities: Create an Item from CreateItemRequest and return the persisted ItemResponse (US-1)
Update an Item by id from UpdateItemRequest, throwing ItemNotFoundException when absent (US-2)
Delete an Item by id, throwing ItemNotFoundException when absent (US-2)
Retrieve one Item by id or all Items, throwing ItemNotFoundException when absent (US-3)
Translate between entity and record DTOs and remain @Transactional

components.name: ItemController
responsibilities: Expose POST /api/v1/items, PUT /api/v1/items/{id}, DELETE /api/v1/items/{id}, GET /api/v1/items/{id} and GET /api/v1/items
Validate request bodies with @Valid and map results to ItemResponse
Apply @Validated id path variables and return correct HTTP status codes (201, 200, 204)
Depend only on ItemService; contain no business logic

components.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
responsibilities: Translate ItemNotFoundException into HTTP 404 with an RFC 7807 style error body
Translate MethodArgumentNotValidException into HTTP 400 listing field violations
Translate ConstraintViolationException and HttpMessageNotReadableException into HTTP 400
Provide a fallback handler returning HTTP 500 without leaking internals

endpoints.summary: Create a new inventory item with a validated name and non-negative quantity; returns the persisted item with generated id
Retrieve a single inventory item by its identifier; 404 when the item does not exist
List every inventory item currently tracked by the service
Update the name and quantity of an existing inventory item; 404 when the id is unknown and 400 on validation failure without mutating state
Delete an existing inventory item by id; returns 204 on success and 404 when the id is unknown

openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Flow Inventory Service API
  description: Auto-generated API contracts for flow-inventory-service conforming
    to Spring Boot 3 / Java 21 Records.
  version: 1.0.0
servers:
- url: http://localhost:8080
  description: Local server
paths:
  /api/v1/items:
    post:
      summary: Create a new inventory item with a validated name and non-negative
        quantity; returns the persisted item with generated id
      operationId: post_api_v1_items
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Successful operation
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ItemResponse'
        '400':
          description: Error response 400
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetails'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CreateItemRequest'
    get:
      summary: List every inventory item currently tracked by the service
      operationId: get_api_v1_items
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Successful operation
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ItemResponse'
  /api/v1/items/{id}:
    get:
      summary: Retrieve a single inventory item by its identifier; 404 when the item
        does not exist
      operationId: get_api_v1_items__id
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Successful operation
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ItemResponse'
        '404':
          description: Error response 404
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetails'
    put:
      summary: Update the name and quantity of an existing inventory item; 404 when
        the id is unknown and 400 on validation failure without mutating state
      operationId: put_api_v1_items__id
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Successful operation
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ItemResponse'
        '400':
          description: Error response 400
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetails'
        '404':
          description: Error response 404
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetails'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/UpdateItemRequest'
    delete:
      summary: Delete an existing inventory item by id; returns 204 on success and
        404 when the id is unknown
      operationId: delete_api_v1_items__id
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Successful operation
        '404':
          description: Error response 404
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetails'
components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetails:
      type: object
      required:
      - timestamp
      - status
      - message
      properties:
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        status:
          type: integer
        message:
          type: string
        details:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
    ItemResponse:
      type: object
      description: Immutable Java Record response for Item
      properties:
        id:
          type: integer
        name: &id001
          type: string
        quantity: &id002
          type: integer
    CreateItemRequest:
      type: object
      description: Immutable Java Record request with Jakarta validation for Item
      required:
      - name
      - quantity
      properties:
        name: *id001
        quantity: *id002

userStories.intent: create a new inventory item with a name and quantity
userStories.benefit: new stock can be tracked from the moment it is registered

scenarios.given: no item exists with name "Widget" and the request body contains a nonblank name "Widget" and quantity 10
scenarios.when: the client sends POST /api/v1/items with the request body
scenarios.then: the service returns HTTP 201 and the persisted item with a generated id, name "Widget", and quantity 10

scenarios.given: the request body contains a blank name and quantity 10
scenarios.then: the service returns HTTP 400 and no item is persisted

scenarios.given: the request body contains name "Widget" and quantity -1
scenarios.then: the service returns HTTP 400 and no item is persisted

userStories.intent: update or delete an existing inventory item
userStories.benefit: inventory records stay accurate and obsolete items can be removed

scenarios.given: an item with id 42 exists with name "Widget" and quantity 5
scenarios.when: the client sends PUT /api/v1/items/42 with name "Gadget" and quantity 20
scenarios.then: the service returns HTTP 200 with the updated item containing id 42, name "Gadget", and quantity 20
the service returns HTTP 204 and the item is no longer retrievable by id

scenarios.when: the client sends PUT /api/v1/items/999 with a valid name and quantity
the client sends PUT /api/v1/items/42 with a blank name
scenarios.then: the service returns HTTP 400 and the item remains unchanged

scenarios.when: the client sends PUT /api/v1/items/42 with quantity -5
scenarios.then: the service returns HTTP 400 and the item remains unchanged

userStories.intent: retrieve an item by id or list all items
userStories.benefit: stock records can be inspected and verified

scenarios.given: an item with id 42 exists with name "Widget" and quantity 10
scenarios.then: the service returns HTTP 200 with the item containing id 42, name "Widget", and quantity 10

scenarios.given: multiple items exist in the inventory
scenarios.then: the service returns HTTP 200 with a list containing all inventory items
